raw_result.task_text: A guest is coming over in 15 minutes. The house should feel welcoming — somewhere comfortable to sit, and something to offer them when they arrive.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare a light snack or beverage by picking up a light object from the kitchen and pass it to R2.
central_instructions.R2: Arrange the living room by pushing furniture if needed and receive the snack or beverage from R1 to place it on the table.
central_instructions.R3: Ensure the bedroom is tidy and assist in passing any light objects if needed.
central_instructions.R4: Check the bathroom for any light objects that need organizing and assist in passing them if necessary.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the mug from the sink basin. (r1_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [PASS] Pass the mug to R2. (r1_s2)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the mug from R1. (r2_s1)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Place the mug on the table in the living room for the guest. (r2_s2)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Assess the living room layout to identify any furniture that needs rearranging for comfort. (r2_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Prepare a snack or beverage for the guest. (r1_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Push the armchairs closer to the coffee table to create a more inviting seating area. (r2_s2)
- R1 [LOCAL] Move towards the living room with the prepared snack or beverage. (r1_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the snack or beverage from R1. (r2_s3)
- R1 [PASS] Hand over the snack or beverage to R2. (r1_s3)
- R2 [LOCAL] Place the snack or beverage on the coffee table. (r2_s4)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up any light objects from the floor and place them on the dresser. (r3_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Arrange pillows neatly on the bed to make it look inviting. (r3_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Ensure the dresser is tidy and free of clutter. (r3_s3)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Open the cabinet to check for light objects like spray bottles or toilet paper. (r4_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Organize any light objects found in the cabinet. (r4_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R4 [PASS] Pass any organized light objects to another robot if needed for further tasks. (r4_s3)
